title: 二座席・双胴式ペダルボート
description: 公園の池や貸しボート区画に配置する二座席ペダルボート。二つの別個の丸い浮体、連結デッキ、低い底と盛上がった縁を持つ二つの足元区画、支持された独立座席、固定ペダル・軸受、後部開口に見えるスポーク付き外輪と駆動覆い、外部舵と手動レバーを造形。一式1点。 最下点をY=0とする水平中央原点です。水面の高さ・喫水位置は配置側で選んでください。水・人物・物理挙動・操縦・浮力・流体力学・救助機能は含まず、静的外形のみです。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.986 × 1.122 × 3.580 m、17,832三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A two-seat pedal boat for park-pond and rental waterfront scenes. Two separate rounded pontoons carry connecting deck bridges, genuinely recessed foot wells, independently supported seats, fixed pedals and bearings. The rear opening exposes a spoked paddlewheel and drive cover; an offset exterior rudder and hand lever distinguish the assembly from a rowing hull. One complete model. The horizontally centered origin places the lowest geometry point at Y=0; choose the waterline and immersion height in your own scene. No water, people, physics, driving, flotation, hydrodynamics or rescue functionality is included: this is a static exterior assembly. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.986 × 1.122 × 3.580 m; 17,832 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
